lead_raw_text:
The Sr2Mg20 structure (SrMg10) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 22 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Sr centers each surrounded by 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg and Sr–Mg contacts dominating the neighbor lists. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, as well as corner and edge sharing between Mg- and Sr-centered polyhedra.
